name: Spike Base BA-10
descriptionHtml:
This ground spike can be stuck into the ground to work as a base for sail sign hardware.

Ball bearings provide smooth, 360º rotation
Pole hardware and flag sold separately
Ground spike is constructed of chrome-plated steel with a nylon polymer bearing cover
Product Size: 20‘’
Material: steel
